content: Konva (via react-konva) is recommended for interactive applications, design editors, and annotation tools in React with built-in hit-testing/event system/drag-drop; PixiJS is WebGL-first, best for high-frame-rate sprite/game workloads; Fabric.js targets image-manipulation design editors. Konva/react-konva have far larger adoption (9.9M/8.3M downloads-month) than DXF-specific viewers, fitting a mid-fidelity structural-drawing viewer with per-entity click-to-select.
